expect.question: What cost-to-collect ratio improvement do organizations with fully integrated RCM systems typically achieve?

set.question: What is the main risk of a best-of-breed RCM technology strategy?
set.explanation: Best-of-breed picks the leading specialized product for each function, which gains depth (for example in denial analytics) but only works if the systems are connected with robust HL7/FHIR interfaces; poorly integrated tools recreate data silos and manual touchpoints. Integrated single-vendor platforms trade some per-function depth for seamless internal data flow.

edits.claim: quiz: fully integrated RCM systems achieve 30-40% lower cost-to-collect
edits.src: No primary source for "30-40% lower cost-to-collect" with fully integrated systems (search 2026-10-09: only vendor case studies and a Black Book self-reported survey citing 27%; nothing matching 30-40%); replacement question tests the lesson’s integrated vs best-of-breed trade-off
